'''Sergey Kitaev''' (Russian: Сергей Владимирович Китаев; born 1 January 1975 in [[Ulan-Ude]]) is a Professor of [[Mathematics]] at the [[University of Strathclyde]], [[Glasgow]], Scotland.<ref>[https://www.strath.ac.uk/staff/?department=Mathematics%20and%20Statistics Staff | University of Strathclyde]</ref><ref>[https://www.strath.ac.uk/staff/kitaevsergeydr Professor Sergey Kitaev | University of Strathclyde]</ref><ref>[http://combinatorics.cis.strath.ac.uk The Strathclyde Combinatorics Group]</ref>
He obtained his Ph.D. in mathematics from the [[University of Gothenburg]] in 2003 under the supervision of [[Einar Steingrímsson]].<ref name="mg">{{mathgenealogy|id=64308}}</ref>
Kitaev's research interests concern aspects of [[combinatorics]] and [[graph theory]]. 

== Contributions ==
Kitaev is best known for his book ''Patterns in permutations and words'' (2011), an introduction to the field of [[permutation patterns]].<ref name="VatterSurvey">{{cite book |last1=Vatter|first1=Vincent|date=2015|chapter=Permutation classes|editor1-last=Bóna |editor1-first=Miklós|title=The Handbook of Enumerative Combinatorics|publisher=CRC Press}}</ref>
He is also the author (with Vadim Lozin) of ''Words and graphs'' (2015) on the theory of [[word-representable graph|word-representable graphs]] which he pioneered. 

Kitaev has written over 120 research articles in mathematics.<ref>[https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/author?authorId=706993 Sergey Kitaev | MathsciNet Mathematical Reviews]</ref><ref>[https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3324-1647 Sergey Kitaev | ORCID]</ref> 
Of particular note is his work generalizing [[vincular pattern]]s to having partially ordered entries, a classification (with Anders Claesson) of bijections between 321- and 132-avoiding permutations, and a solution (with Steve Seif) of the word problem for the Perkins semigroup, as well as his work on word-representable graphs.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Steingrímsson |first1=Einar |author1-link=Einar Steingrímsson|title=The history of the Gothenburg–Reykjavík–Strathclyde Combinatorics Group |journal=Enumerative Combinatorics and Applications |date=2023 |volume=3 |issue=1 |pages=Article S1H1 |doi=10.54550/ECA2023V3S1H1|url=http://ecajournal.haifa.ac.il/Volume2023/ECA2023_S1H1.pdf}}</ref>
